name: video-pip
note: Round 9 (operator UAT 2026-08-10): (1) 'minimize the video INTO the now playing - use PIP overlay - Minimize is the CTA when open': the bar CTA reads Minimize; minimizing flips the SAME .bt-st-media element to a fixed PIP docked above the bar (iframe never remounts - audio never dies), tap the PIP to expand, and the PIP survives the whole Studio minimizing to the bar. Native requestPictureInPicture is unreachable for a cross-origin YT iframe, so the PIP is a CSS overlay by design. (2) 'support scrub on progress bar': pointer-drag seeks (seekTo command) with the fill tracking the finger optimistically - proven via a synthesized infoDelivery duration. (3) friction 'changing apps stops music... shows active with no sound': on visibility return the bar presumes PAUSED (backgrounding always pauses a non-Premium embed) - proven via a synthetic visibilitychange.

steps.label: arrange: video open (vidopen), the bar CTA reads Minimize, and the iframe node is fingerprinted for the never-remounts proof
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidopen'))return false;var l=document.querySelector('.bt-st-vidmin-lbl');if(!l||l.textContent.trim()!=='Minimize')return false;var f=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media iframe');if(!f)return false;window.__pipFrame=f;return true;})()

steps.label: MINIMIZE -> PIP: the media is position:fixed, ~152px wide, floating ABOVE the bar, the SAME iframe node still connected (audio alive), and the menu now offers Expand video
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(m);if(cs.position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>60))return false;var bar=document.querySelector('.bt-st-head').getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.bottom<=bar.top+2))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(f!==window.__pipFrame||!f.isConnected)return false;var vt=document.querySelector('[data-vidtoggle]');return !!vt && vt.textContent.trim()==='Expand video';})()

steps.label: SCRUB: synthesize the embed's duration report, then pointer-drag the progress bar to ~60% - the fill tracks the finger and lands at 60, same iframe untouched
steps.js: (function(){window.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:JSON.stringify({event:'infoDelivery',info:{duration:100,currentTime:10}})}));var p=document.querySelector('[data-npprog]');if(!p)return false;var r=p.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>0))return false;var x0=r.left+r.width*0.2,x1=r.left+r.width*0.6,y=r.top+r.height/2;function ev(type,x){p.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type,{pointerId:7,clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));}ev('pointerdown',x0);ev('pointermove',x1);ev('pointerup',x1);var now=parseInt(p.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'),10);var w=parseFloat(document.querySelector('[data-npfill]').style.width);return now===60 && Math.abs(w-60)<2 && document.querySelector('.bt-st-media iframe')===window.__pipFrame;})()

steps.label: REFOCUS HONESTY: a visibility return while marked playing flips the bar to PAUSED (play glyph, npPaused class) - backgrounding always pauses the embed, the bar must never lie
tap the PIP -> the video EXPANDS back in place (vidopen, no .min), iframe still the same node
the PIP SURVIVES the whole Studio minimizing to the bar - still fixed, still visible above the now-playing bar, over the library list
